How: Adapter-generated settings and dotenv accepted by Gemini CLI with no model/endpoint/key flags; native GenerateContent inference before and after each apply/clear. The fake endpoint validates x-goog-api-key for the requested model. HOME and workspace are temporary; GEMINI_CLI_HOME differs from HOME and native sessions must appear under its .gemini directory. --skip-trust is native ephemeral automation consent, not a stored trust record. Keys are synthetic; native login is not read.
